entries.label: Abyssal scanner
entries.description: A deep submersible's view: marine snow, bioluminescent animals, and a sonar fan that identifies them.

entries.label: Ages
entries.description: A thousand years of a continent from above: hearths become cities, roads and borders spread, wars and sieges, plagues and hordes, wonders, and lights in the dark.

entries.label: Approach radar
entries.description: An air traffic control scope: sweep, fading returns, arrivals, departures, and typed clearances.

entries.label: Deephold
entries.description: A dwarven kingdom in cutaway: a range of mountains with two to four rival holds, each building its own way (ladders, lifts, or stairs; arched, domed, or vaulted halls; torches, braziers, crystal, or lava), and never stopping. They dig deeper, carve great halls and galleries of kings, cut highways to each other, trade, go to war, and fall and are retaken; a dragon comes over the peaks; and something below may wake. Each seed draws its own cast.

entries.label: Leylines
entries.description: A realm seen from high up, drawn like a fantasy map: orders of mages of seven schools raise towers on the wells of the ley lines, walk the land to claim, bless, and search ruins, duel with fireballs, lightning, ice, and vines, and go to war with summoned elementals; storms, a dragon, rifts, falling stars, and great rituals under the converging moons.

style.label: Style (the realm of towers and mages, the ink network, or the first version)

hud.label: The orders, the moons, the chronicle

entries.label: Martian weather radar
entries.description: Dust storm radar over Jezero: contours, drifting storm cells, sweep-refreshed reflectivity, dust devils.

entries.label: Petri dish
entries.description: Artificial life under a microscope: strains that feed, hunt, divide, engulf, and colonize, a contamination at the rim, a drifting focus, and a notebook naming what is found; or a Lenia culture of gliding creatures.

entries.label: Seismograph
entries.description: A seismic record: station traces trembling, quakes sweeping across the stack, the crust below.

entries.label: Shieldwall
entries.description: Pitched battles and sieges in pixel sprites: shieldwalls, volleys, cavalry charges, towers at the walls, mages, standards, night fighting by torchlight, and sometimes a dragon. A war of five battles, then a new one.

entries.label: Sonar waterfall
entries.description: A submarine's passive sonar: contacts drifting across a scrolling bearing-time waterfall.

entries.label: Undercity
entries.description: A 2.5D cyberpunk city at night: layered towers and an open megastructure, air traffic, trains, crowds, rain, and netrunners breaching corp ICE.

speed.label: How fast the city drifts past

entries.label: War table
entries.description: A campaign on a parchment map: orders in ink, painted tokens moved by an unseen hand, sealed dispatches that can be taken or forged, the fog of what the council cannot see, the light of the seasons, and the wax seal of a peace.

entries.label: Wyrmspire
entries.description: A valley under a wyrm’s spire, through a watchtower’s spyglass: a different land and breed of wyrm each seed; herds, harvests, caravans, and festivals; a wyrm that basks, hunts, hoards, and raids; a lord who fortifies, pays tribute, or sends heroes up the spire path.
